name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '09' is the meaningful chapter id (chapters 01-30 per the FDFIELD/FDTXT chapter set and the chapter-end dispatch table @ 0x51DE9), not an address residue (own address is 0x235bc, unrelated to 09). Descriptor 'end' correctly marks it as the chapter-end (post-clear) handler, paired with fd2_chapter_09_init @ 0x3327D.
purpose: Chapter 9 (騎士的抉擇) end handler: revives runtime char #11 (clears its status flags), plays the post-battle cutscene (pan window, refresh portraits, fire cutscene event, dialog page 4), persists the party, then advances to the next chapter.
logic_summary: Sets data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[0xb].flags = 0 to revive char #11 (clears all status flags; the char was previously asleep/disabled, so this re-enables it rather than recruiting a new member). Pans the view window via fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(6,1), refreshes the portrait cache for race 4 via fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(4), fires cutscene event 0x24 via fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x24), shows chapter-end dialog page 4 via fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, 4, ...), persists the party via fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template(), then increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id by 1. In the binary the function tail-jumps (JMP 0x231C6) into the +0xA shared tail of fd2_chapter_04_end (PUSH chapter text; dialog page 4; cleanup; save; INC chapter id; RET); emitted self-contained for Layer-2 functional equivalence.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only (char #11 revived, cutscene/dialog played, party persisted, current chapter id advanced).

notes: No params: __cdecl void; the decompiler's in_stack_* are artifacts of the __CHK stack-probe builtin (PUSH 0x28; CALL 0x36cd7), not real arguments. Disassembly confirms body: load runtime-char base [0x53a45]+0x370 (0xb*0x50 = char #11), MOV byte [+5],0 (flags field at struct offset 5, matching siblings ch02/ch10 which also use .flags), pan(6,1), portraits(4), cutscene(0x24), then JMP 0x231C6 into fd2_chapter_04_end +0xA shared tail (dialog page 4; save; INC chapter id). Dispatch verified: dword @ 0x51E09 = bc 35 02 00 = 0x000235bc (this fn), next slot f9 35 02 00 = fd2_chapter_10_end; offset from table base 0x51DE9 is 0x20 = slot index 8 (0-based engine chapter index for chapter 9). Source comment (lines 379-410) and Ghidra plate both accurate and consistent with the binary; the plate's terse 'Body (61B)' is compatible (not contradictory) with the source's fuller description, so left unchanged. Source .flags field name vs Ghidra plate's bFlags is a struct-naming difference only, not a logic discrepancy. No source edit needed (comment already precise + ASCII-clean).
